description: This file contains wrapper functions for PHP-XMLRPC, including functions for type conversions, function wrapping for XML-RPC methods, dynamic class and function generation, and client code building to facilitate remote XML-RPC communication.

methods.name: php_2_xmlrpc_type
methods.description: Converts a PHP type string to its corresponding XML-RPC type constant or value.

methods.name: xmlrpc_2_php_type
methods.description: Converts an XML-RPC type string to its corresponding PHP type.

methods.name: wrap_php_function
methods.description: Creates a wrapper function for a user-defined PHP function to expose it as an XML-RPC method.

methods.name: wrap_xmlrpc_method
methods.description: Generates a PHP wrapper function for calling a remote XML-RPC method via a client.

methods.name: wrap_xmlrpc_server
methods.description: Creates a PHP class that wraps all remote XML-RPC methods exposed by a server.

methods.name: build_remote_method_wrapper_code
methods.description: Builds PHP code for invoking a remote XML-RPC method, returning source code and documentation.

methods.name: build_client_wrapper_code
methods.description: Generates PHP code to rebuild and initialize an XML-RPC client object.
